question: Should OpenClaw runtime Docker/Podman containers expose the agent workspace at `/workspace`, or should `/workspace` remain reserved for sandbox containers with runtime docs updated accordingly?
rationale: Both outcomes are plausible, but the choice changes container setup behavior, Podman/Docker parity, and sandbox path semantics across user-facing install surfaces.

options.title: Implement consistent runtime alias
options.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke coverage.

options.title: Document sandbox-only semantics
options.body: Keep runtime containers on `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` and update docs/templates that imply `/workspace` is generally available.

options.title: Resolve DooD path contract first
options.body: Let the adjacent Docker-outside-of-Docker sandbox path issue settle host/container path semantics before adding a runtime alias.

recommendation.title: Implement consistent runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest recent Docker/setup/docs history and already own adjacent canonical Docker path-contract triage.
